explanation: No Mathlib lemma states this result. I grepped all theorem/lemma names containing toSpecΓ in Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry and looked for statements of the form `… ≫ toSpecΓ = Spec.map …`. Mathlib has the ingredients: the definition `Scheme.Opens.toSpecΓ := U.toScheme.toSpecΓ ≫ Spec.map U.topIso.inv`, `Scheme.toSpecΓ_naturality` and `SpecMap_ΓSpecIso_hom`. The library's proof combines these, which is more than one declaration plus glue. The closest Mathlib statements are fixed instances of the same pattern: `fromSpecStalk_toSpecΓ`, `Opens.fromSpecStalkOfMem_toSpecΓ`, `IsAffineOpen.fromSpec_toSpecΓ` and `Scheme.Opens.toSpecΓ_SpecMap_appLE`. Each fixes the morphism, whereas this theorem allows any `g : Spec R ⟶ U`, so none of them covers it.
